synthesizedFacts.fact: Mineral sunscreens are considered safer for both human health and the environment compared to chemical sunscreens.
Chemical sunscreens can contain ingredients like oxybenzone and octinoxate, which may cause endocrine disruption and harm marine life.
The American Academy of Dermatology recommends using a sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher for effective protection against UV rays.
Mineral sunscreens use zinc oxide or titanium dioxide to physically block UV rays, while chemical sunscreens absorb UV radiation and convert it to heat.
